title: Apple pulls AI ‘nudify’ app promoted in Meta ads - 9to5Mac
summary: WIRED reports that Meta ran ads for a now-pulled App Store app that let users create AI-generated pornographic deepfakes of real people, with one of the ads featuring a woman resembling a prominent US politician.
